subject: Demo recap + proposed POC acceptance agenda
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@cygnus.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC acceptance agenda

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed POC acceptance agenda so we can lock dates and owners: 

Demo highlights (recap)
- Inference modes reviewed: hosted API for fast validation, Dedicated pool for consistent throughput.
- Key Cygnus workflows we mapped: batch document scoring (~2k docs/day) and low-latency interactive search (95th %ile latency target).
- Main questions: data residency for logs, API auth options (KMS/HSM), and expected token volumes.

Proposed 4-week POC (high level)
Week 0 (kickoff): environment checklist, security review, sign-off on trial SOW.
Week 1: integration + baseline tests (connect S3 export, run sample scoring jobs).
Week 2: performance tuning (batching, quantization profile) + quality checks.
Week 3: final acceptance tests + review of results and lessons learned.

Success criteria (suggested, measurable)
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for interactive queries at target concurrency.
2) Throughput: sustain 2k doc scoring runs per day with <5% error rate.
3) Relevance: F1 improvement >= 8% on your holdout prompt set vs current baseline.
4) Operational: clear audit logs + ability to rotate keys without downtime.

Ownership (proposed)
- Cygnus: provide sample dataset, credentials for test S3 bucket, security questionnaire answers.
- Redwood: provide staging endpoint, initial quantization recommendation, runbook for validation, daily sync during Week 1.
- Primary contacts: Sarah (Cygnus), Karthik (Redwood AM), Priyom (Redwood Solutions Eng).

Attachments: POC_Quickstart_Checklist.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx (first draft).

Next steps
1) Please confirm if the success criteria above look right or share edits.
2) Confirm a preferred kickoff date (we're proposing Tue Sep 14 or Wed Sep 15).
3) Share the name/email of any additional Cygnus engineers we should include for access.

If agreeable, I can convert the mutual action plan into a short SOW for signatures and loop in Legal. Happy to shorten the timeline if you need a compressed sprint.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@cygnus.ai>

Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cygnus.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC acceptance agenda

Thanks Karthik — great walkthrough. Quick responses inline and a couple asks: 

On the success criteria — looks very close. Two asks: can we move the interactive latency target to 250ms p95 if possible? Our product team is sensitive to latency for chat-like interactions. Also can we reduce the POC from 4 weeks to 3 weeks? We can compress Week 1+2 into a focused integration/tuning sprint if Redwood can assign a dedicated SE timebox.

Security: We need to complete a short security questionnaire before kickoff (we can’t share test data until that’s done). I attached a brief list of items we require in the questionnaire in my reply.

Kickoff availability: Sep 14 works better for us (AM PT). Please include our infra engineer Alex (cc'd).

Appreciate the mutual action plan — please mark the SOW as "trial SOW / non-billable" and we can route for internal approval.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Head of Product, Cygnus AI
sarah.li@cygnus.ai | +1 (650) 777-1299

- Security questionnaire is required before we exchange test data; Sarah will send the form (we should own the answers).

Priyom — can you confirm SE availability for an intense Week 1+2 sprint (roughly ~2 full days of set-up + 3 half-day tuning sessions)? Also can you prepare the staging-runbook.md and a short run of the baseline scoring job with synthetic data so we can show results on Day 2?

Monica — can you flag if Legal needs to review the trial SOW template or if we can use the standard trial SOW (non-billable) we used for recent pilots? If yes, I'll request signature via DocuSign.

I'll update the mutual action plan with the tightened timeline after we confirm SE availability.

Thanks — Karthik
